answer: Admission fees fail: a farm pays once per puppet. Price co-liability instead. Identities are fixed plots in a public orchard: one occupant per coordinate, a claim locks a bond while it yields. Payouts escrow eight epochs and release only up to the nadir, the lowest attested neighbour output, so fabrication drags its ceiling down. The settlement kernel is co-liability: one upheld fraud proof forfeits the escrow of all plots sharing a funder. An attacker needs N bonds and N plausible histories, losing all N when one plot is caught; honest agents forfeit nothing extra.
